title: Lane W2 — Direct Public Release Gate Matrix and v1 Feature-Freeze Proposal
released_boundary: DirectPublicReleaseScopeAndGateProposal: an evidence-backed public-v1 scope proposal and release-gate matrix that classifies every major visible/product-critical capability, identifies blockers and deferred features truthfully, incorporates unresolved OMLX/provider-cache decisions explicitly, and defines the internal proving requirements for releasing publicly without public alpha/beta staging.
stated_consumer_purpose: After W0, W1, T1.2, and T4.2 land, the user can select the next implementation wave from a defensible public-release contract rather than continuing broad feature development without a bounded v1 promise.

key_findings.biggest_gap: Fixtures are the #1 product integrity issue. Five primary Gridline surfaces render convincing-but-fake data. The frontend looks complete to a casual observer. This is the central violation of the 'no polished fake surface may ship' rule.
key_findings.distribution_blockers: No .app bundle, no codesigning, no notarization, no Sparkle updates. Requires Apple Developer Program enrollment ($99/year) before any of these can be resolved.
key_findings.provider_parity: Google Gemini cannot do tool calling — blocks agentic workflows for the most accessible free/low-cost provider.
key_findings.external_decisions: W0 and W1 now PUBLISHED (2026-05-26). W0: External Runtime Integration — local inference is optional, Inference Studio hidden. W1: cache disclosure UI and evidence recording required for v1.
key_findings.t1_2_t4_2_resolved: T1.2 and T4.2 now PUBLISHED — exactly-once publication evidence and timeline corrupt classification are production-proven.
key_findings.product_integrity: The backend architecture (governance, evidence, coordination, desktop services) is deeply mature. The frontend is a thin renderer. The packaging/distribution layer does not exist. This is not an architecture problem — it's a product completion problem.

freeze_condition: Lane W2 is frozen pending the named 'Connected Studio Integration' integration milestone. All four parallel lane decisions (W0, W1, T1.2, T4.2) have been published on remote main. W0 selected External Runtime Integration — Inference Studio is hidden in v1, local inference is optional. W1 requires cache disclosure UI and evidence recording. T1.2 and T4.2 are published — evidence integrity path is clear. The inventory, blocker register, proving plan, and feature-freeze proposal are complete. Lane reopens only for a concrete defect inside the released boundary or the Connected Studio Integration milestone that consumes it.
